messages:
sofia: :rotating_light: paging alert — p99 generation latency crossed 5.2s for the streaming endpoint (prod-usw). Observed stalls in token streaming; clients reporting partial chunks. Triggering incident. thread created by pagerduty.

pagerduty: [automated] Incident INC-4521 created. Severity: sev2. Acknowledged by raj (eng-oncall). Primary: eng-oncall. Channels: #incidents, #eng-runtime. Escalation policy=prod-streaming-latency. Link: https://pd.example/INC-4521

raj: oncall here, acknowledge. Looking at p95/p99 graphs now. Can someone post top-5 hosts by p99?

infra-bot: Top p99 hosts (last 10m): gpu-node-23: p99=8.3s, gpu-node-47: p99=6.1s, gpu-node-19: 5.5s, gpu-node-02: 4.2s. Thermal throttle spikes on gpu-node-23. ECC corrected errors++ on gpu-node-23 (84 -> 130 in last 15m). Metrics: `node:gpu_thermal_throttle_total{node="gpu-node-23"} 18`

kim: I can start mitigation. Steps proposed:
1) Enable fallback routing to `model-7b-quant-cpu` for streaming routes (reduce GPU pressure)
2) Drain suspect node(s) for maintenance
3) Temporarily reduce max tokens to 512 for streaming sessions

jordan: Customer impact: CS reported interruptions for three paying customers using streaming websockets (acct ACCT-998, ACCT-432, ACCT-201). They see stalled streams and reconnect loops. Ticket numbers: #T-789, #T-790.

maria-cs: adding: ACCT-998 is a healthcare customer on Dedicated — high priority. They've opened a live call and want ETA.

sofia: executing step 1 now. Updating routing policy: 
```
redwoodctl routes update --env prod --service streaming --set fallback=model-7b-quant-cpu --session-limit 512 --reason "mitigate GPU tail latency"
```

sofia: routing change deployed to control-plane (requests starting to shift). Seeing immediate drop in CPUbackpressure but p99 still high for legacy sessions.

raj: initiating drain of gpu-node-23: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-23 && kubectl drain gpu-node-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — will migrate active sessions.

infra-bot: Drain started. Active LBs rebalanced. Note: current GPU driver shows repeated ECC corrected logs: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:05:00): 79, Graphics SM stopped responding, resetting` — suggests flaky GPU resets.

ops-bot: Suggest power-cycle of GPU host if drain completes but errors persist. Thermal profile shows fans at 4600rpm, ambient temp 29C. Could be rack cooling issue.

kim: On hardware contact now — paging hw-support@vendor. If ECC errors + SM resets, hardware swap may be required. Requesting temporary capacity increase: spin up 4 x burst-dedicated GPUs in us-west to keep SLA.

jordan: I'll inform the customers: telling them we have a mitigation in flight (fallback routing + node drain). ETA tentative 20-30m. Asking for approval to open temporary burst capacity.

maria-cs: Approved to spin up burst GPUs for ACCT-998 only. We'll bill per agreement.

sofia: Burst capacity requested: `infractl scale --pool prod-burst-usw --gpu 4 --type a100 --ttl 2h` — submitted.

infra-bot: New instances provisioning. Estimated ready in ~9m.

raj: Drain succeeded on gpu-node-23, node rebooted by ops during maintenance. Post-drain p99 for node-23 still shows occasional spikes on reintroduced sessions; removing node from rotation until hw confirmation.

ops-bot: Hardware vendor confirmed they saw ECC corrected errors and sm reset logs. RMA recommended if issues repeat after reboot. Logged vendor ticket: VEND-3145.

kim: For now, we've kept fallback in place and reduced token caps. p95 improved from ~450ms to 210ms in 15m window, p99 dropped from 4.8s -> 1.1s overall. Streaming stall reports down from 26 -> 3.

jordan: Good. Customer call update: ACCT-998 extremely relieved; they'll monitor. ACCT-432 still seeing intermittent stalls — flagged for escalation to Dedicated eng.

sofia: Handing off to night oncall (raj -> kim) at 2026-03-14 03:41 UTC. Summary posted to incident doc: https://docs.redwood/INC-4521

sofia: Action items:
- hw team to validate gpu-node-23 and RMA if recurring (kim)
- keep fallback routing until next-day stability review (sofia)
- reconcile cost for burst GPUs with finance (maria-cs)

kim: Acknowledged. I'll follow up with vendor and set a fw-up check. Will re-run heavy streaming load tests once replacement or fix confirmed. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: [automated] Incident INC-4521 status updated to mitigated. Monitoring continues. Close after 24h stable.

sofia: Thanks team. Closing active paging. Will create postmortem if vendor RMA or if p99 breaches repeat. :white_check_mark:
